Verify error lists valid template options
Verify exit codes are non-zero for errors

description: Template rendering test: Complex model with all features
steps: Create User model with: 10 fields of various types, 3 relationships, 5 validation rules, 2 indexes, 3 optional fields, 2 default values
Verify Jinja2 template renders without errors
Verify all fields are present in output
Verify all validations are in Field() definitions
Verify all relationships have correct type hints

description: Naming convention test: snake_case to camelCase conversion in Dart
steps: Create model with fields: user_id, first_name, last_name, created_at, updated_at, is_active
Verify Dart fields use camelCase: userId, firstName, lastName, createdAt, updatedAt, isActive
Test JSON deserialization with snake_case keys
Verify Dart model correctly maps snake_case to camelCase
Test JSON serialization produces snake_case keys
Run dart analyze and verify no warnings

description: Parser robustness test: Malformed YAML edge cases
steps: Test with YAML using tabs instead of spaces
Verify error message explains YAML doesn't support tabs
Test with missing colon after key
Test with invalid characters in model names
Verify all errors are clear and actionable

description: Generator output test: Verify file permissions and structure
steps: Verify generated files don't include executable bit
Verify no temporary files are left behind

description: Pydantic v2 specific features test
steps: Create User model with ConfigDict settings
Verify model uses Pydantic v2 syntax (not v1)
Verify Field() instead of deprecated validators
Verify ConfigDict is imported and used
Instantiate model and verify v2 behavior
Verify code is Pydantic v2 compatible

description: Freezed code generation test: Verify build_runner compatibility
steps: Generate models.dart with User and Post models
Create test pubspec.yaml with freezed dependencies
Test JSON serialization via generated code
Run dart analyze on all generated files

description: Large schema performance test: 100+ models generation
steps: Generate test schema with 100 models (User01 through User100)
Each model has 10 fields and 2 relationships
Verify total time is under 30 seconds
Verify generated Python file is valid
Verify generated Dart file is valid
Run type checkers on large generated files

description: Incremental generation test: Only regenerate changed files
steps: Generate initial code for User model
Record modification time of generated files
Modify schema: add field to User
Verify only Python and Dart model files are regenerated
Verify Docker compose is NOT regenerated (unchanged)
Verify both model files are regenerated
Verify output indicates which files were skipped/updated

description: Validation rule completeness test: All Pydantic validators
steps: Create fields with: ge (>=), le (<=), gt (>), lt (<), min_length, max_length, regex
Verify each validator appears in Field() definition
Test validation with invalid values (too small, too large, wrong format)
Verify all validators work as expected
Verify generated validators match schema definitions

description: Schema versioning test: Handle schema version upgrades
steps: Verify warning about old schema version
Verify warning about newer schema version
Verify generation proceeds or fails appropriately
Verify version check logic is correct

description: Generated code readability: Python models have clear structure
steps: Generate models.py with User, Post, Comment models
Verify models are separated by blank lines
Verify imports are at the top and organized
Verify each model has a docstring
Verify fields are aligned and readable

description: Generated code readability: Dart models have clear structure
steps: Generate models.dart with User, Post, Comment models
Verify each model has doc comments (///)
Verify code follows Dart style guide
Verify field names use proper camelCase
Verify overall structure is clean and professional

description: CLI help text organization and clarity
steps: Verify help text is organized: usage, options, arguments
Verify each option has clear description
Verify help text explains all flags: --target, --watch, --dry-run
Verify help uses colors and formatting
Verify help is easy to scan and understand

description: Error message quality: Clear, actionable, user-friendly
steps: Trigger various errors: missing schema, invalid YAML, validation failure
For each error, verify message includes: what went wrong, where (file/line), how to fix
Verify errors use color coding (red for errors)
Verify errors include context (surrounding code if applicable)
Verify errors are concise but complete
Verify errors don't include stack traces for user errors
Verify technical errors include debug info when --verbose is used

description: Progress output polish: Professional and informative
steps: Run: schnitzel generate with multiple models
Verify spinners or progress bars are smooth
Verify each step is clearly labeled
Verify output feels polished and professional
Compare with popular CLIs (npm, cargo) for quality

description: Documentation comments in generated code are helpful
steps: Generate code with various field types and relationships
Verify comments are generated from schema descriptions if present
Verify comments follow language conventions (# for Python, /// for Dart)

description: Integration test: FoodieAI schema with all features
steps: Load FoodieAI schema (User, Recipe, Ingredient, Review, Category models)
Verify schema includes: relationships, validations, optional fields, defaults
Generate Python models for all FoodieAI entities
Generate Dart models for all FoodieAI entities
Verify Review belongsTo User and Recipe relationships
Run pyright on all generated Python code
Run dart analyze on all generated Dart code
Run build_runner for Freezed code generation
Verify all models compile without errors
Test instantiation of each model with sample data
Verify JSON serialization round-trip for all models
Verify this represents a real-world schema successfully generated
